changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingreservation AS SELECT br.id, br.reservation_number, br.wallet_id, br.payment_id, br.payment_transaction_id, br.patient_id, br.encounter_id, br.charge_id, br.charge_line_id, br.charge_responsibility_id, br.patient_service_product_id, br.original_reserved_amount, br.remaining_reserved_amount, br.consumed_amount, br.released_amount, br.currency, br.status, br.reserved_date, br.consumed_date, br.released_date, br.cancelled_date, br.release_reason, br.release_notes, br.released_by, br.cancelled_by, br.cancellation_reason, br.previous_reservation_id, br.idempotency_key, br.transaction_group_id, br.created_by, br.created_date, br.last_modified_by, br.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_reservation br;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingreservation TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingreservation FROM report_user;
